metadata.chapter_subtitle: Tracking snowpack evolution through the winter season

inventory.summary: The chapter needed a clearer setup around SWE as the central hydrologic variable.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.
The distinction between snow depth and SWE needed to be stated earlier.
The opening needed a gentler bridge into the seasonal mass-balance model.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added onboarding and made SWE the clear organizing concept from the start.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified the difference between depth and water equivalent.
Smoothed the transition into operational melt modelling.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now keeps the seasonal snow-accounting logic clearer for first-time readers.

repair.summary: The chapter's accessibility issues were repaired during the rewrite.
actions_taken: Clarified SWE before the formal model.
Improved the conceptual pacing into the melt equations.

design_review.summary: The chapter's seasonal modelling storyline now better supports the later examples and visuals.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support around SWE as the quantity that matters for runoff forecasting.
